The main takeaway from our work is that

the subgrid scale closures derived here can be used to improve the accuracy of the sediment flux computation in local transport models and thus the reliability of the predictions of any model that uses local transport models as a component.

the scale-dependence and scale-independence of hillslope sediment flux can be assessed via a theoretical analysis and that the subgrid scale sediment flux model can be used in conjunction with high resolution topographic data to derive scale-independent sediment flux models from low resolution topographic data.

the scale-dependence is an inherent feature of local nonlinear hillslopes sediment transport models and thus any attempt to parameterize such models from low-resolution DEMs is bound to fail unless a scale-independent subgrid scale closure is employed.
